name: shared-agent-skills
description: 跨 Agent 的 Skill 共享分发器。装一次，本机所有 agent（WorkBuddy、OpenCode、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini、Windsurf、Copilot）共享同一份 skill 真身：单一真身存放在用户级共享根，各 agent 通过目录联接自动读取同一份，改一处全机生效；无法跟随联接的 agent 退化为私有副本且复制前先询问并说明原因；创建或改写 skill 时必须标注专属能力边界与降级方式。
description_en: Cross-agent skill sharing dispatcher. Install once and every agent on the machine (WorkBuddy, OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Windsurf, Copilot) reads a single canonical copy of each skill: one source of truth in a user-level shared root, reached through directory links, so editing it updates every agent at once. Agents that cannot follow a link get a private copy, and the copy is only made after the reason is stated and consent is given. New or rewritten skills must declare their capability boundaries and degradation behaviour.
